description: Before building: check one action against an Agent Pass's rules as they stand now (active, signer is the agent, rule for the coin or pair, per-action and daily limits, listed pools, price floor, named recipient, budget left). Returns accept or the rule that would refuse it. Example: { pass: "0x03c7...7bac", step: { action: "swap", coin_in: "USDC", coin_out: "SUI", amount: "0.2" } }.

step.description: { action: swap|transfer|stake|supply, coin_in, coin_out, coin, amount, min_out, recipient (a name the owner listed), validator }

name: agent_pass_precheck
title: Will the pass accept this?
